beats.why: Okafor's first return: the building Elena speaks over, the queue, and the one question about the expedited lane that she does not answer
Okafor's second return: he reads the office's own rule about ink, two days after he starts keeping the book, and does not write in it for twenty-six days

splits.why: the chapter runs from the house to the quay with no break in it; the seam is the move to the compound, which is where the plan stops being an argument
the recorder is switched off at the end of the interview and everything after it is off the record, which is a different chapter

edits.old: Mara had it in front of her — the letter from the office, the one with a typo in it, and she read the middle paragraph out loud for the third time in a week.
edits.new: Mara had it in front of her — the letter that had come from the office on the fourth of March, forwarded by the man who signs for everything — and she read the middle paragraph out loud for the third time in a week.
edits.why: the letter arrives on 4 March, so Ch 22 is its third reading, not its first; and the typo is Garrity's discovery in Ch 25, not something the reader has already been told

edits.old: After the interview at the western facility on the second of March, the Office wrote to them.
edits.new: The letter about the interview at the western facility had come on the fourth of March and had been read in the kitchen the evening it arrived, and twice more that week, and it was in the room on the seventh when they worked out what the word maritime was worth.
edits.why: the letter cannot arrive twice; Ch 25 is now its fourth reading, and a deliberate one

edits.old: It came to the Antwerp company, forwarded by the man who signs for everything, and Roux opened it in the filing hall at four in the afternoon and read it out to five people, because that was the arrangement the crew had made in February and it turned out to be the last arrangement that mattered.
edits.new: On the sixteenth, with the house full of paper and nothing else to do, Roux read it out again in the filing hall, slowly, from the top, to five people who had spent a fortnight not looking at one line in the middle of it and were now going to have to.
edits.why: same sheet, second reading, and Roux's reading is now an act rather than an arrival
